verdict: Paid campaigns are dark; organic local presence is holding steady across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, no paid spend ran in the last 28 days — zero leads were generated through Meta or Google Ads at any location. All 391 combined Google Business Profile actions (including 22 calls and 275 direction requests) came entirely from organic local presence, which means local demand exists but no paid channel is in place to capture it. Advance Grinding's profile activity rose 52% week over week, a positive signal; however, both Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision saw their profile actions decline sharply in the most recent 7 days. Three CRM setup milestones — due as far back as July 7 — remain unconfirmed complete, and closing those out is the prerequisite for the outreach and automation work scheduled through Q4.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid advertising running
week-over-week rise in Advance Grinding's local profile activity, the strongest organic movement across the group this period
the longest any of three overdue CRM milestones has gone unconfirmed, with all three now being actively resolved

watch_item.issue: Three CRM setup milestones across the group are overdue by 30 to 54 days, blocking the pipeline sync and outreach sequences that follow them.
watch_item.fix: Completion of these milestones is being prioritized now, with the next scheduled checkpoint — 342 account records reconciled — set for August 31.
